full_text:
Article 2 (Survey of Resources)
The survey of resources under Article 10 (1) of the Framework Act on Emergency Preparedness (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") and Article 9 (1) of the Enforcement Decree thereof (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree") shall be conducted once each year, as of December 31, with respect to enterprises subject to priority management under Article 3 of these Rules. <Amended on December 16, 2022>
